historical_experiment_check.exp-20260503-053: Old role discriminator used narrow data; this uses broad archive plus low-liability confirmation.
historical_experiment_check.exp-20260604-022: Cost-basis entry alignment did not beat raw Form4 replacement sufficiently.
historical_experiment_check.exp-20260605-001: Liquidity-intensity was positive only versus core and failed raw replacement/sample gates.
historical_experiment_check.exp-20260614-018: Broad clustered Form 4 open-market buys failed; reflection allowed timing or cluster-quality edge before retry.
historical_experiment_check.exp-20260614-019: Owner-conviction ratio failed; reflection allowed CEO/CFO non-plan buys paired with fundamental confirmation.
historical_experiment_check.why_not_repeat: This is not cluster count, owner count, liquidity intensity, cost basis, or low-liability threshold tuning; it tests one fixed role + accepted-fundamental confirmation bundle.

hypothesis: PIT SEC Form 4 CEO/CFO/President non-plan open-market purchases, when paired with already-known SEC Companyfacts low-liability confirmation, may isolate informed insider demand with better replacement value than broad clustered or owner-conviction Form 4 buys.

llm_metrics.why_not_llm: The tested fields are deterministic, free SEC data plus OHLCV; LLM soft-ranking remains sample-limited.

market_regime_summary.mid_weak: rotation-heavy bull where strategy makes money but lags indexes
market_regime_summary.old_thin: mixed-to-weak older tape with lower win rate

next_action: Do not retry nearby Form 4 role/fundamental confirmation without a new non-threshold evidence source or forward closed paper outcomes.

parameters.form4_role_rule: CEO/CFO/President from issuer officer title or explicit is_ceo/is_cfo flags; excludes vice-president titles unless CEO/CFO also present
parameters.low_liability_rule_source: accepted fundamental_growth_rs_low_liability_support_v1 threshold; reused as context, not retuned
parameters.selection_order: entry_date asc, CEO/CFO first, lower liabilities/assets, total_purchase_value desc, ticker asc

post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retune CEO/CFO/President title parsing, liabilities/assets threshold, purchase value floor, hold days, notional, capacity, or sort order on this archive.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: A valid retry needs forward closed paper outcomes or a genuinely new evidence source such as buy-size relative to executive compensation/holdings from a shared daily surface.
post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The role/fundamental bundle was not enough to overcome the broad Form 4 failure pattern. Either executive open-market buys remain mostly reactive, or low liabilities/assets overlaps already accepted Companyfacts quality without adding enough event timing value.

prediction.confidence_reason: Broad clustered Form4 and owner-conviction failed, but their reflections allowed CEO/CFO non-plan buys paired with fundamental confirmation.

production_impact.production_consistency_read: No live/default production surface changed. A positive replay result is only a lead until this exact bundle is moved to a shared default-off helper used by historical replay and daily paper snapshots with parity tests.

source_diagnostics.pit_status: uses Form 4 usable_trade_date plus Companyfacts filed date <= usable_trade_date; entry/exit prices come after signal formation
